name: Chem-User
summary: Chem-User; Once per long rest, inject combat chems as a bonus action. Gain +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks for 1 minute. Afterwards, make a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.  Chem-User; You gain advantage on saving throws against poison and combat drugs.  Chem-User; Once per long rest, ignore the exhaustion risk from your combat chems.
descriptionMarkdown:
Chem-User; Once per long rest, inject combat chems as a bonus action. Gain +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks for 1 minute. Afterwards, make a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

Chem-User; You gain advantage on saving throws against poison and combat drugs.

Chem-User; Once per long rest, ignore the exhaustion risk from your combat chems.
